lines.say: Every way to keep your clients, ranked with real 2026 data.
Tier F, doing nothing. Squire's own data: forty-eight percent of clients book once.
Tier D, paying for new clients. Book-see Boost takes thirty percent of the first visit.
Tier C, asking at the chair. It misses everyone who already left.
Tier B, texting them yourself. Works, until you have hundreds of clients.
Also tier B, Vuh-gair-oh. Text marketing is a twenty dollar add-on.
Tier A, Book-see. Two thousand marketing texts included, but extra barbers cost twenty each.
Gloss Genius, from twenty-four a month. The biggest text allowance is one forty-eight.
Squire, fifty a month for the shop, with retention reports.
Tier S, Message Health. Scores every client, texts the quiet ones for you.
Comment KEEP to get a full retention audit.
